name: McDonald's
description: McDonald's is a global fast-food chain known for its burgers, fries, and quick service. Ideal for a casual meal, it offers a variety of options suitable for all ages and dietary preferences, making it a popular choice for a quick and satisfying bite.

name: Onsen Japanese
description: Noodle Nook offers authentic Asian noodle dishes in a cozy setting. Their signature spicy ramen is loved for its rich broth and perfectly cooked noodles. A great spot for casual dining with family or friends, serving flavorful and comforting dishes.

name: Kebab House
description: Kebab House serves delicious Middle Eastern kebabs with fresh ingredients and flavorful spices. The mixed kebab plate features a variety of grilled meats, perfect for a quick, satisfying meal on the go. Friendly service in a casual environment.

name: The Five Star Grill
description: A luxurious fine dining experience featuring premium ingredients and impeccable service. The signature seared Wagyu beef is renowned for its melt-in-your-mouth texture and rich flavor. Perfect for special occasions and romantic dinners, offering an unforgettable culinary journey.

name: Cafe de flora
description: City de flora offers a relaxed atmosphere with a diverse menu featuring specialty coffees, fresh pastries, and healthy breakfast options. Their signature avocado toast is a hit, combining fresh ingredients with expert preparation for a perfect start to your day.

name: The Local Pub
description: A cozy pub offering classic Australian pub fare and a wide selection of local craft beers. The beer-battered fish and chips is a local favorite, served with tartar sauce and crispy chips. Perfect for casual gatherings and enjoying a relaxed atmosphere.

name: Viet Garden
description: Viet Garden offers authentic Vietnamese cuisine in a welcoming setting. Their signature Pho Bo features fragrant broth, tender beef, and rice noodles, providing a comforting and flavorful experience. Ideal for family dinners or casual outings.
